contract: Shared contract for receipt design v2 (web client-v2/src/lib/receipt-layout.ts ⇄ app lib/services/receipt_layout.dart). This file is copied byte-for-byte to the app (test/fixtures/receipt_layout.fixtures.json); both sides pin its sha256 (web: RECEIPT_FIXTURES_SHA256). Change it in both repos together.

resolveReceipt(design, input) → {density, emoji, mono, label_align, value_align, blocks}. Pure: no clock, no I/O, no HTML. `design` is the stored design object (partial v1 keys + optional `layout`); `input` is the ReceiptInput of each case. Every case's `expected` must deep-equal the resolver output (all keys present, null where empty, numbers compared numerically: 1 == 1.0).
Renderers draw ONLY the resolved blocks; a stored design WITHOUT `layout` keeps the old v1 renderer unchanged on both sides (the resolver is still defined for it: missing layout = all defaults).

v1 keys read by the resolver (default when the key is absent): show_logo, show_shop_info, show_subscriber_info, show_package_info, show_package_price, show_transaction_info, show_footer, show_manager_signature, show_receipt_id, show_datetime (default true; only the boolean false switches off); header_align, footer_align, logo_align, qr_align ∈ right|center|left (default center); default_align ∈ right|center|left|justify (default right). Invalid values ⇒ default.

Tolerant layout parsing (never throws): density ∉ DENSITIES ⇒ 'normal'; emoji = (layout.emoji !== false); mono = (layout.mono === true); fields/sections only for known ids, each property kept only with the right type (show/bold boolean, label/title string, size ∈ SIZE_STEPS); titles only string values for known kinds; texts: walk the array in order, skip entries that are not objects, whose `at` ∉ TEXT_POS or whose `text` is not a string, stop after 6 accepted; text id = given non-empty string else 't'+(accepted index+1); align ∈ right|center|left else 'center'; size ∈ SIZE_STEPS else 'md'; bold = (bold === true); boxed = (boxed === true); only = known kinds in KINDS order (empty ⇒ every kind).

Field visibility: a field whose FIELD_DEFS[id].v1 is set (receipt_no, issued_at, package_price, issuer) is visible iff that v1 switch is on (fields[id].show is ignored); every other field is visible unless fields[id].show === false. scale = SIZE_SCALE[fields[id].size ?? 'md']; bold = fields[id].bold if boolean else FIELD_DEFS[id].bold.

Labels: if fields[id].label is a string, the label is that string trimmed ('' = no label); otherwise the default FIELD_DEFS[id].label, except LABEL_VARIANTS: amount on a payment receipt ⇒ 'المبلغ المسدَّد', balance_credit when the balance is exactly 0 ⇒ 'الرصيد'. Table rows carry label null when it is ''. shop_name, title and footer_text never use labels; qr_caption's label IS the caption text ('' ⇒ caption null).

joinLabel(label, value) for inline fields (shop_address, shop_phone, receipt_no, issued_at, issuer): l = label.trim(); '' ⇒ value; l ends with '#' ⇒ l + value; l ends with ':' ⇒ l + ' ' + value; else l + ': ' + value.

Text cleanup: str(x) = x.trim() for strings, String(n) for finite numbers (an integral value prints with no decimal point: 30 ⇒ '30', never '30.0'), '' otherwise. Money fmtMoney(n) = round(|n|) with ',' thousands + ' د.ع' (e.g. '25,000 د.ع'). Display name = str(subscriber.name) || str(subscriber.username). Shop name = str(shopName) || 'MyServices'. Expiry text = first 16 UTF-16 units of str(expiration).

Block order: (1) texts at 'top'; (2) logo if show_logo && hasLogo; (3) shop_name if visible; (4) shop_lines if show_shop_info — address then phone, each only if it has a value and is visible, text = joinLabel(label, value), icons pin/phone, block skipped when empty; (5) title if visible: custom = titles[kind] trimmed; text = fill(custom).text if custom non-empty and that text is non-empty, else fill(DEFAULT_TITLES[kind]).text (titles never hide); (6) texts at 'after_title'; (7) meta {no, at}: no = joinLabel(label(receipt_no), receiptId) if show_receipt_id && kind ≠ sale && receiptId non-empty; at = joinLabel(label(issued_at), issuedText) if show_datetime && issuedText non-empty; skipped when both null; (8) body; (9) texts at 'before_qr'; (10) qr if hasQr && kind ≠ sale, caption = label(qr_caption) when visible and non-empty else null; (11) footer if show_footer: issuer line (visible && issuer non-empty, joinLabel) then footer_text line (if visible: footerText split on line breaks, each line trimmed, empty lines dropped, joined with '\n'; empty ⇒ DEFAULT_FOOTER with icon 'pray', else icon null); skipped when no lines; (12) texts at 'bottom'.

Body, non-sale kinds: subscriber section (show_subscriber_info): subscriber_name (display name, if non-empty), username, phone (each only if non-empty). Package section (show_package_info): package_name (value str(packageName) || '—', always present when visible), package_price (if > 0, money), expiry_date (if non-empty), days_remaining (if a number: '<n> يوم'). Transaction section (show_transaction_info): activation/extension ⇒ payment_type (if set, PAYMENT_TYPE_LABELS), amount (if a number), cash_paid (partial-cash with a partialAmount); payment ⇒ amount; info ⇒ none of these; then the balance when newBalance is a number: < 0 ⇒ balance_debt (tone 'debt'), ≥ 0 ⇒ balance_credit (tone 'credit' when > 0, null when 0). A section with no rows is dropped. Section title: null if sections[id].show_title === false; else sections[id].title trimmed if non-empty, else SECTION_TITLES[id]; '' ⇒ null.

Body, sale (only when input.sale is set): sale_void if voided ('مُلغاة' or 'مُلغاة — <reason>'); sale_customer section (show_subscriber_info): subscriber_name (display name || 'زبون'), username, phone (if non-empty; field show/label/size/bold apply); sale_items {title, lines:[{name, detail:'<qtyText> × <money(unitPrice)>', total: money(total)}]} always; sale_totals section always, fixed rows sale_total (tone 'total') and sale_payment (bold, scale 1, ltr false); sale_note 'ملاحظة: <note>' when the note is non-empty. No QR and no receipt number in meta on sales.
Rows: {id, label, value, ltr = FIELD_DEFS[id].ltr, bold, scale, tone}. label_align = default_align; value_align = the physical opposite: right|justify ⇒ left, left ⇒ right, center ⇒ center.

Variables (fill): /\{([a-z_]+)\}/ tokens whose name is in VARIABLES are replaced (no re-scan of inserted values); any other {…} stays literal. A variable whose kinds do not include the receipt kind is ''. Then every line: runs of [ \t\u00a0] ⇒ one space, trimmed; empty lines dropped; lines joined with '\n'. hidden = result '' OR (≥1 known variable and every known variable empty). Hidden texts are not emitted.

Variable values: shop_name (as printed), shop_phone, shop_address, receipt_type = RECEIPT_TYPE_LABELS[kind], receipt_no = receiptNoText, date / time = issuedText split at its first space, issuer, subscriber_name = display name, firstname = first whitespace-separated word of str(subscriber.name), username, phone, package_name, sas_package_name = str(sasPackageName) || str(packageName), package_price (money if > 0), expiry_date (expiry text), days_remaining = '<n>', remaining_days = '<n> يوم', payment_type (label), amount (money), paid_amount (payment ⇒ amount; cash ⇒ amount; partial-cash ⇒ partialAmount; non-cash ⇒ 0; else ''), debt_amount (money when newBalance < 0), credit_amount (money when > 0), balance ('دين <money>' / 'رصيد <money>' / '0 د.ع'), sale_total (money), sale_payment ('على حساب المشترك (دين)' | 'نقداً').

Rendering tokens: final font px = round(font_size_base × RATIOS[value|label|caption] × scale) (subtitle/title box from font_size_title × 0.8 × scale; shop name = font_size_title × scale). DENSITY values are web px; the app uses pt = px × 0.75. tone 'debt' red / 'credit' green / 'total' = subtitle size, weight 800 (colours dropped when mono or on POS in the app). emoji (web only): 📍 before shop_address, 📞 before shop_phone, 🙏 after the default footer (icon 'pray'). Tashkeel is kept in resolved text; the app strips it when drawing.

fixtures/2 (receipt designer v3). The frozen first file is receipt-layout.fixtures.v1.json (sha256 d18f3130…) in both repos. Cases c01–c17 keep their inputs; their expected outputs gain the v3 keys at neutral values. Clauses 17–32 extend 1–16; where they differ, they win.

17. v: clients parse any object as a layout; v is ignored for rendering. A client saves v = max(3, stored v) and never lowers it (compactLayout emits v: 3, or the stored integer v when it is above 3).

18. Tolerant parse of the v3 props (fields, sections, blocks and texts alike): pt kept only when it is a number in PT_STEPS; align only in right|center|left; row_mode only stack|value (line = absent); gap_before/gap_after only numbers, clamped to 0–10 and rounded to the nearest 0.5 (round half up), 0 = absent; sep only in SEPS; only = the known kinds in KINDS order, an empty result = every kind. Section only exists for subscriber/package/transaction. Fields are read for ALL_FIELD_IDS (21 + the 3 reserved). Texts: at must be in TEXT_POS3 (else the text is skipped), the rest as clause 4. currency: a string, trimmed, one line, at most 8 code points (else the default «د.ع»; "" = no unit). digits: latin|arabic (default latin; phase 2 — not rendered yet). types is retired and ignored.

19. Block order: the known ids of order.blocks (BLOCK_IDS), deduplicated in first-occurrence order, then every missing id in default order. It applies to every kind (sales too). Slots: top before the first block; after_shop after shop_lines; after_title after title; after_meta after meta; before_qr before qr; before_footer before footer; bottom after the last block; after_subscriber/after_package/after_transaction after their body section (on a sale: after sale_customer, after sale_items, after sale_totals before the note). A slot emits its texts even when its anchor block does not print. Texts in one slot keep their array order.

20. Body order (non-sale kinds): sections = order.body ∩ BODY_SECTION_IDS (dedup) then the missing ones in default order. Fields per section: walk the sections in canonical order (subscriber, package, transaction) and take order[section] ∩ ROW_FIELD_IDS, skipping ids already placed; then append every unplaced id to ROW_FIELD_SECTION[id] in ROW_FIELD_IDS order. rowFor(id) keeps the v2 eligibility per kind and value (clause 10); reserved ids resolve to no row in phase 1; a section with no rows is dropped (its after_* slot still prints). Sales keep their fixed structure (clause 11): order.body and the field lists do not apply to them.

21. Visibility: element visible = base visibility (v1 switch or show, as before) AND (only absent or kind ∈ only). Applies to fields (rows, inline lines, meta parts, caption, shop_name, title), body sections (with show_*_info) and containers: logo (show_logo && hasLogo), shop_lines (show_shop_info), meta, qr (hasQr && not sale), footer (show_footer). The sale void stamp, items, totals and note are never hidden; the sale customer section follows show_subscriber_info only (its rows follow their fields).

22. Labels with {vars}: a custom label (rows, inline fields, caption) or section title is trimmed; "" = no label (rows/inline) or the default title (sections). If it contains at least one KNOWN variable it goes through fill(): hidden ⇒ the default label (FIELD_DEFS / LABEL_VARIANTS) — or null for the caption, or the SECTION_TITLES default (null when that is "") for a section title — else the filled text. A label with no known variable is only trimmed (inner spaces kept, unknown {x} literal). Type titles keep clause 9. Footer text and the shop columns never take variables.

23. Size: pt = the explicit PT_STEPS value or null (also on texts, the shop name, the title, shop/footer lines, meta parts (no_pt/at_pt), the caption (caption_pt) and section titles (title_pt)); label_pt = round(pt × 0.9 × 2) / 2 when pt is set, else null (6→5.5, 7→6.5, 8→7, 9→8, 10→9, 11→10, 12→11, 14→12.5, 16→14.5, 18→16, 20→18, 24→21.5). scale = SIZE_SCALE[size] as in clause 5 when pt is null, and 1 when pt is set (pt replaces size; compactLayout drops size then). Sale fixed rows (sale_total, sale_payment) always resolve pt/label_pt null.

24. Alignment and row modes: rows get align = explicit or null (renderers: line ⇒ value cell row.align ?? value_align; value-only ⇒ row.align ?? label_align; stack ⇒ one cell aligned row.align ?? label_align with the label above the value). stack = (row_mode == stack); row_mode value ⇒ label null. shop_name, title, every shop line, every footer line and the caption resolve align = explicit or the legacy default (header_align for shop name/title/shop lines, footer_align for footer lines, qr_align for the caption), so they are never null. Inline fields (shop_address, shop_phone, receipt_no, issued_at, issuer): line ⇒ joinLabel(label, value); value ⇒ value; stack ⇒ label + "\n" + value (value alone when the label is empty); lines carry stack = (row_mode == stack).

25. Meta: split = (receipt_no has align) || (issued_at has align). no_align/at_align = explicit or header_align when split, null otherwise. no_pt/at_pt = explicit pt or null; no_bold/at_bold = the field bold (default false). no_gap_before/no_gap_after/at_gap_before/at_gap_after = the fields' gaps (0 default; drawn only when split). The meta block's own gaps/sep come from blocks.meta; its sep replaces the density meta line.

26. Gaps and seps: every block, row and shop/footer line carries gap_before, gap_after (mm, default 0) and sep (default null). Sources: logo/shop_lines/meta/qr/footer ⇐ blocks[id]; shop_name, rows, lines ⇐ fields[id]; title ⇐ fields.title gaps, sep always null; section, sale_items ⇐ sections[id] gaps, sep always null; text ⇐ the text; sale_void and sale_note 0/0/null. A row sep (including none) overrides row_separator and the last-row rule; other elements draw a line only when sep is set (none = no line).

27. Money: fmtMoney(n, currency) = round(|n|) grouped with "," + (currency == "" ? "" : " " + currency); it applies to rows, sale lines, totals and the money variables (package_price, amount, paid_amount, debt_amount, credit_amount, balance, sale_total). remaining_days keeps " يوم".

28. digits: "arabic" (phase 2) maps the digits of money, counts, the receipt number and dates to U+0660–U+0669 with U+066C as the thousands separator. Phase 1 resolvers ignore it (output unchanged); the server and compactLayout keep it.

29. v2 stays v2: for a layout without v3 keys the resolved output equals the fixtures/1 expected once the v3 keys are removed (stripV3), and every removed key is at its neutral value (gaps 0, sep null, pt/label_pt null, row align null, stack false, line align = its block align, caption_align = qr align, caption_bold false, split false, meta part keys null/false/0, title_pt/title_align null). Both test suites prove it over c01–c17 and c30.

30. compactLayout(raw) → the layout to save, or null when nothing differs from the defaults (the receipt then stays on the v1 renderer). Output: v (clause 17); density ≠ normal; emoji false; mono true; currency ≠ «د.ع»; digits arabic; per element only the props in its caps (FIELD_CAPS / SECTION_CAPS / CONTAINER_CAPS) and only when not default: show false (fields with show cap), label trimmed when ≠ the default label (any string for reserved ids), size ≠ md and only when pt is not set, bold ≠ the default bold, pt, align, row_mode stack|value, gaps > 0, sep, only with 1–4 kinds; section title trimmed when ≠ SECTION_TITLES, show_title false; type titles trimmed when ≠ DEFAULT_TITLES; texts with blank text dropped, renumbered t1..tN, align ≠ center, size ≠ md (only without pt), bold/boxed true, only 1–4 kinds, pt, gaps > 0, sep; order lists only where the resolved order differs, each cut to the shortest list that resolves the same (trailing ids the resolver appends back are removed); unknown top-level keys verbatim; types dropped. Pinned by compact_cases.

31. TEMPLATES / applyTemplate(state, id): state = {paper_size, design (v1 keys), layout}. Result: paper_size = template.paper_size; design = {...design, ...template.v1}; layout = {...layout, v: max(3, layout v), density: template.layout.density, mono: template.layout.mono}. Fields, sections, blocks, texts, titles, order and emoji are untouched (pinned pt stays pinned). Pinned by template_cases (expected and expected_compact).

32. sanitize_cases come from the server (server/receiptDesign.js cleanLayout, copied verbatim): each is {name, note, layout or design, expect} — expect = the cleaned layout (or null) of mergeDesign(design ?? {layout}, null) — or {name, note, layout or design, error: {code, path}} (HTTP 400; messages are Arabic and not pinned). Server rules: strict when layout.v is a number >= 3 (only 3 is accepted); null on an optional key = absent; lengths in code points after NFC + cleanStr, over the limit = LAYOUT_TOO_LONG (never cut); every /\{([a-z_]+)\}/ token in labels, section titles, type titles, texts and the caption must be in VAR_IDS (else LAYOUT_UNKNOWN_VAR); paths are dotted with [i] (fields.username.pt, texts[1].text, order.package[0], design.<key>); cleaned v3 layout <= LIMITS3.layoutBytes. Save protocol: GET data.updated_at (ISO UTC, null without a row); POST sends if_updated_at (the loaded value, null included) and gets the new updated_at back; 409 STALE_DESIGN when the stored row changed since; 409 LAYOUT_NEWER when no token is sent and a stored v>=3 layout would be dropped or downgraded; 413 BODY_TOO_BIG above 1 MB. Clients do not run the server cleaner; they check that compactLayout keeps the MEANING of every valid case (the same resolved receipt for all five kinds) — not its bytes, because compactLayout also drops default values and trims order lists. The server pins its tokens to these (PT_STEPS, SEPS, ROW_MODES, DIGITS, BLOCK_IDS, CONTAINER_IDS, ROW_FIELD_IDS, TEXT_POS3, VAR_IDS, FIELD_CAPS, SECTION_CAPS, CONTAINER_CAPS, TEXT_CAPS, LIMITS3, V1_ALL_DEFAULTS == sanitizeV1({})).
